newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares lose 0.72pct in market correction.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares lose 0.72pct in market correction.

text.p: The Athens bourse saw another profit-taking session on Thursday with the general share index settling 0.72 percent lower but brokers expected the market to rebound soon.
"This was another typical session of profit-taking. The bourse has a clear upside potential however and I believe it will soon rebound," said broker Giuseppe Gianno at Euroxx Securities.
The general share index could correct more on Friday but the overall trend is upwards and there is no reason for concern, he added.
"The bourse will soon regain momentum and reach 1,450 points, where it will hit a resistance level," he said.
Large capitalisation stocks continue to be attractive to investors. Specifically, shares of industrial, metallurgical and telecommunications companies will soon rise, said Gianno.
"Banking shares will rise selectively. I think many investors are waiting for the index to fall a little further before they selectively become repositioned in certain stocks," he added.

The Athens general share index closed 0.72 percent or 10.26 points lower at 1,419.02 from Wednesday's 1,429.28 close, after opening at 1,424.58. The session's high was at 1,428.07 and its low at 1,409.76 points.
Turnover dropped to 14.4 billion drachmas on volume of 4.1 million shares. Decliners led advancers 121 to 92, with 33 issues unchanged on 246 traded.
Sectoral indices were mixed. Banks lost 0.57 percent but construction rose slightly, up 0.03 percent. Industrials remained unchanged at 941.40 points, while leasing shares dropped 1.02 percent.
Small caps ended down 0.14 percent and investment shares closed 0.17 percent lower.
